label: D1 after two unrewarded trials, the last one ending in S2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), and almost only when the reward input is 0 (95% of mass on prev_reward==0). It is strongest when the trial just finished ended in S2 unrewarded and the trial before was also unrewarded, a run of losses that points to S2 being bad. Its lift goes along with good==S1, an upcoming a1 choice, a positive policy logit (a1) and lower value. All of the predicate variables are observed. Scores on dev: D1&prev_reward==0 has P 0.14 / R 0.93; adding prev_state==2 gives F1 0.40; adding the earlier no-reward gives P 0.70 / R 0.73 / F1 0.71 / mass 0.78. Most of the missed mass is at rel -3 D1, where the window holds no earlier history, plus weak firing after a single loss or in S1. Remaining false positives are mostly long-reward-streak contexts where the loss run is too short. This suggests the feature tracks accumulated evidence against S2 / for switching to a1, not a crisp event. Requiring S2 on both trials hurts recall badly (F1 0.49). Using the upcoming choice (action==1) instead adds little.
